onboardingModule_description.message: Opens a welcome page in a new tab after the extension is installed. What it shows is set for each module with the option “Show module output: On the welcome page”; the button opens it again at any time.

onboardingModule_opens_after_install.message: $1: after the extension is installed, the welcome page opens in a new tab.

onboardingModule_not_opening.message: $1: the welcome page won't open after installation — the module's activation mode is not “After the extension is installed”.

onboardingModule_already_open.message: The welcome page is open right now.
